fields.title: Facebook page review record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of the page's rating and its reviews. One PAGE_RATING row per page, one REVIEW row per review, one RUN_SUMMARY per run, ERROR rows when a page cannot be read. Facebook changes its payload without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The page slug this record answers for.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: page_unavailable or unexpected_error.

ratingSummaryText.title: Rating summary
ratingSummaryText.description: Facebook's own sentence, e.g. '30% recommend (12,651 reviews)'. Kept verbatim next to the parsed numbers.

recommendPercent.title: Recommend (%)
recommendPercent.description: Percentage of reviewers who recommend the page. Facebook retired star ratings for pages, so this IS the rating - there is no 4.3-out-of-5 to report and this actor does not invent one.

reviewCount.title: Total reviews
reviewCount.description: How many reviews the page has in total, which is usually far more than a run collects.

reviewsEnabled.title: Reviews switched on
reviewsEnabled.description: False when the page shows no recommendation summary, i.e. reviews are turned off. The run then legitimately collects nothing.

reviewsCollected.title: Reviews collected
reviewsCollected.description: How many reviews this run kept for the page, after filters.

reviewId.title: Review ID
reviewId.description: REVIEW rows: the review's post id.

reviewerName.title: Reviewer
reviewerName.description: Name of the person who left the review.

reviewerId.title: Reviewer ID
reviewerId.description: Facebook id of the reviewer. Newer accounts appear as an opaque pfbid token rather than a number.

isRecommended.title: Recommends
isRecommended.description: True, false, or null when the sentence Facebook rendered could not be read. Null is never silently turned into false.

reviewTitle.title: Recommend sentence
reviewTitle.description: Facebook's own line above the review, e.g. "Mike Phipps doesn't recommend Domino's Pizza." - the only place the vote appears in the payload.

reviewText.title: Review text
reviewText.description: The written review. Null when the reviewer voted without writing anything.

tags.title: Experience tags
tags.description: Facebook's structured tags on the review, e.g. ['Disappointing food', 'Casual'].

createdAtIso.title: Posted at
createdAtIso.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the review.

commentCount.title: Comments
commentCount.description: Comments on the review post, including any reply from the business.

overview.title: Reviews
overview.description: One row per review: who, what, when and which way they voted.

ratings.title: Page ratings
ratings.description: One row per page: the headline rating and how much of it this run sampled.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.description: Negative reviews with their text and tags - the view a brand manager wants.
